label.en: Bottles, cans, containers, plastics, styrofoam, small electronics

label.en: Paper, clean clothes, clean plastic bags, books

label.en: Batteries, bulbs and tubes, cooking oil, pesticide containers

note.en: Free for households. Call your district cleaning squad (or 1999) at least one day before. Pickup Mon–Sat, none on Sunday. Many squads ask you to put it out after 9 pm.
note.zh: 家戶免費。至少前一天打給轄區清潔隊（或 1999）預約時間地點。週一至週六收運，週日不收。多數清潔隊請你晚上 9 點後再拿出來。

note.en: No official rule found yet — ask before throwing it out.
note.zh: 尚未查到官方規定，丟之前請先詢問。

text.en: General household trash must go in an official bag (Taipei per-bag fee).
text.zh: 一般家戶垃圾必須裝在專用垃圾袋（臺北市垃圾費隨袋徵收）。

text.en: Recyclables and food waste, sorted as required, are collected free — no official bag needed.
text.zh: 依規定分好的資源回收物和廚餘免費回收，不用專用袋。

text.en: Fill only up to the line printed on the bag. About 30% above the line is left for tying. Tie it with the handles, rope or tape. Do not squeeze it so hard that it tears or leaks.
text.zh: 裝到袋上的容量上限線為止，線上約 30% 留作綁口。用提耳、繩子或膠帶綁好。不要過度擠壓，以免破裂、滴漏。

text.en: New Taipei official bags (including their dual-use and all-purpose bags) are also accepted in Taipei.
text.zh: 新北市專用垃圾袋（含環保兩用袋、萬用袋）在臺北市也可以使用。

text.en: Bags 33 L and up are flat-top; 25 L and under have handles. Real bags carry an anti-counterfeit label.
text.zh: 33 公升以上為平口式，25 公升以下為提耳式。真品有防偽標籤。

text.en: Not using an official bag can be fined from NT$1,200.
text.zh: 未使用專用垃圾袋，可處 1,200 元起罰鍰。

dualNote.en: Dual-use bags are the shopping bags sold at supermarkets and chain convenience stores. You can only get them with a purchase (no packs, no buying them alone). After shopping, use them as official garbage bags.
dualNote.zh: 環保兩用袋是量販店、超市、連鎖便利商店結帳時的購物袋，只能購物時依需求購買（不整包賣、未購物不可單獨買）。購物後可當專用垃圾袋使用。

advice.en: Suggestion, not a rule: pick the smallest bag that fits what you actually throw out, by volume and weight, with room left to tie it. Small amounts thrown out often: start with 3 L or 5 L. A few days of household trash: compare 14 L and 25 L. More than that: 33 L and up. A photo of one item cannot tell how big your whole bag needs to be.
advice.zh: 產品建議（非規定）：依實際要丟的體積和重量，挑能裝得下又能綁口的最小規格。少量且常倒：從 3 或 5 公升開始；累積幾天的家戶垃圾：比較 14 和 25 公升；更多再考慮 33 公升以上。拍一件物品無法推算整袋需要多大。

text.en: Squash it to save space.

handover.en: Put it in a Taipei official garbage bag, tie it, and throw it into the garbage truck yourself.
handover.zh: 裝進臺北市專用垃圾袋、綁好，自己丟進垃圾車。

title.en: Out of the blister, into a zip bag
Mix with used tea leaves or coffee grounds

text.en: So nobody can pick them out.
text.zh: 避免被誤食或撿用。

title.en: Seal it and put it in general trash

warn.en: Do not pour medicine down the sink or toilet. Special medicines (e.g. anti-cancer drugs) go back to a hospital or pharmacy.
warn.zh: 不要倒進水槽或馬桶。抗癌藥交回醫院或藥局。

handover.en: Put it in a Taipei official garbage bag, tie it, and throw it into the garbage truck yourself.
handover.zh: 裝進臺北市專用垃圾袋、綁好，自己丟進垃圾車。

text.en: So the crew does not get cut.
text.zh: 避免割傷清潔人員。

warn.en: Ceramics are not recyclable but cannot be burned, so they go to the recycling truck, wrapped.
warn.zh: 陶瓷不能回收，包好交給回收車。

handover.en: Hand it to the recycling truck crew, wrapped.
handover.zh: 包好交給資源回收車。

verify.en: We could not find a current official rule for broken glass.
verify.zh: 目前查不到碎玻璃的現行官方規定。

text.en: Wrap it in thick paper and write "broken glass" on it, so nobody gets cut.
text.zh: 用厚紙包好並寫上「碎玻璃」，避免有人割傷。

handover.en: We could not find an official rule for this item. Call your district cleaning squad or 1999 before throwing it out.
handover.zh: 目前查不到這項物品的官方規定。丟之前請先致電各區清潔隊或 1999 確認。

text.en: Call your district cleaning squad or 1999 at least one day before. Tell them your address and the items; they set the day, time and place.
text.zh: 至少前一天打給轄區清潔隊或 1999，說明地址和物品，清潔隊會約定日期、時間與地點。

text.en: Usually after 9 pm on the agreed day. Do not add items you did not book.
text.zh: 多半是約定日晚上 9 點後。不要夾帶未預約的物品。

warn.en: Do not leave furniture on the street without booking. Households only — shops and companies arrange their own.
warn.zh: 沒預約不能丟路邊。只收家戶的。

name.en: TV, fridge, washer, A/C, range hood
name.zh: 電視、冰箱、洗衣機、冷氣、抽油煙機

text.en: Call your district cleaning squad or 1999 at least one day before.
text.zh: 至少前一天打給轄區清潔隊或 1999 預約。

text.en: General trash must go in a Taipei City official garbage bag (New Taipei bags are accepted too). Sizes 3 L–120 L, e.g. 14 L: NT$100 for 20 bags, or NT$5 for one retail bag. See "Official garbage bags" for sizes and where to buy.
text.zh: 一般垃圾必須裝在臺北市專用垃圾袋（新北市專用袋也可以）。容量 3–120 公升，例如 14 公升一包 20 個 100 元，零售單個 5 元。容量與代售點請看「專用垃圾袋」。

tip.en: Recycling, food waste and bulky-waste pickup are free — no special bag needed.
tip.zh: 資源回收、廚餘與大型廢棄物預約收運都免費，不需專用袋。

warn.en: Not using an official bag can be fined from NT$1,200 (Waste Disposal Act).
warn.zh: 未使用專用垃圾袋，依廢棄物清理法可處 1,200 元起罰鍰。

text.en: 1. General trash (official bag)  2. Recycling (any bag)  3. Food waste (a box or bag).
text.zh: 1. 一般垃圾（專用袋）2. 資源回收（任何袋子）3. 廚餘（盒子或袋子）。

tip.en: Not sure? Use "What is this item?" on the home page.
tip.zh: 不確定？用首頁的「這是什麼垃圾？」查詢。

text.en: No collection on Wednesday and Sunday. Suggested days for recycling: paper & clothes Mon / Fri; bottles, cans & plastics Tue / Thu / Sat. Sorted recyclables are still accepted on the other collection days.
text.zh: 每週三、日停收。回收建議日：紙類、舊衣一、五；瓶罐、塑膠二、四、六。分類好的回收物在其他收運日也會收。

tip.en: Lunar New Year has a special schedule announced by the Department of Environmental Protection.
tip.zh: 農曆春節收運時間依環保局公告調整。

text.en: The truck stops at fixed places at fixed times, usually only a few minutes. Arrive 5 minutes early.
text.zh: 垃圾車在固定地點、固定時間停靠，通常只停幾分鐘，請提早 5 分鐘到。

tip.en: Missed it? The city runs limited-time drop-off points in every district.
tip.zh: 錯過了？各區有環保局的限時收受點。

text.en: Trucks play music as they come (often "Für Elise"). A recycling truck runs on the same route.
text.zh: 垃圾車來時會播放音樂（常見為〈給愛麗絲〉），同路線也有資源回收車。

text.en: Throw the official bag into the garbage truck. Give recyclables to the recycling crew. Pour food waste into the blue bucket at the back of the truck.
text.zh: 專用袋丟進垃圾車；回收物交給回收車人員；廚餘倒進車後方的藍色廚餘桶。

warn.en: Never leave trash on the street or by a pole — Taipei has no curbside bins. You can be fined.
warn.zh: 不可把垃圾放在路邊或電線桿旁（垃圾不落地），會被開罰。
